contract.purpose: Group planned-day ERP orders by trailing status and carrier type.
inputs_defaults: Only explicit declaration defaults permit omission; catalog has_default_value is not used to infer T-SQL defaults.
null_and_invalid_input_behavior: COUNT ERP_ORDER omits NULL identifiers. Independent MAX expressions can select representatives from different detail rows. A NULL date argument does not match the day predicate; datetime zero is not today.
output_shape: TrailingStatus, TRAILING_STS, CARRIER_TYPE and one fixed-name building total.

ordered_branches.explanation: First groups all shipment details by ERP_ORDER and independently takes MAX internal shipment, item and category plus SUM quantity. Joins only the selected maximum shipment header, so a shared ERP order is attributed to one header. Filters planned date to the supplied calendar day, permits NULL launch but excludes49906/49910, and applies fixed customer category. Counts non-NULL ERP_ORDER; no positive-quantity filter. Fixed status/carrier label maps, then outer sum by selected building constants; orders carrier/status. Default date0 is SQL datetime origin, not today.

NO_CAPTURED_REFERENCE means none of the credited channels in this exact retained corpus identified the table. It does not establish that the table is unused, obsolete, a backup, safe to delete, or absent from external application SQL.
